mapper.select: select * from cr_task_submit where task_id = #{taskId} order by evaluate_time desc limit 1
select * from cr_task_submit where task_id = #{taskId} order by evaluate_time desc

select cr_task_submit.resource_id, cr_mission.title, cr_mission.description, cr_task_submit.answer as user_answer, cr_mission.answer, cr_mission.type, cr_mission.`option`, cr_mission.skill_points, cr_mission.write_up, cr_mission.score from cr_task_submit left join cr_task on cr_task_submit.task_id = cr_task.resource_id left join cr_mission on cr_task.mission_id = cr_mission.resource_id where cr_task_submit.resource_id = #{taskSubmitId}
